notes.subject: יבערו
notes.rationale: בער means both 'burn/kindle' and 'be brutish' — the idol of wood is both fuel and fool; the pun is lost.

notes.subject: ובאחת
notes.rationale: 'as one / at one time / in one thing' — rare construction; rendered 'u bɛɛ ye kelen ye' (together as one).

notes.subject: hɛbɛlɛw
notes.rationale: הבלים kept as the Hebrew marker-word 'hɛbɛlɛw' (vapors, vanities) rather than collapsed to 'batofɛnw'.

translation: O kɔfɛ, u bɛɛ ye kelen ye, u bɛ ka gɛlɛya kɛ, u tɛ faamu: hɛbɛlɛw ka kalan ye jiri de ye.
